project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project the library belongs to.

source_path.title: Source Path
source_path.description: Current path, relative to the library's code directory, of the file/folder to move.

target_parent_path.title: Target Parent Path
target_parent_path.description: Destination parent folder path, relative to the library's code directory. Omitted/None moves to the library root.

type.title: Type
type.description: Kind of entry being moved: "file" or "folder".
